scenePrompts.public/art/night-ferry/cake.webp: Landscape 3:2. At night just inside the Puxi ferry waiting shelter, the reference fictional adult woman with grey windbreaker half opens a small plain pastel pink cardboard cake box on an old stainless rail shelf. A slightly lopsided small white cream cake inside; a small turned-away decoration plaque with no visible lettering. A single short yellow candle in transparent packet lies by box. She turns her eyes to her friend by camera, relaxed after a long day, faintly amused. Ferry gangway lights through window and warm neutral light from next to the ticket barrier. Keep box and face both in central 70 percent.
scenePrompts.public/art/night-ferry/cabin.webp: Landscape 3:2. Evening about a year later inside a modest operating Shanghai passenger ferry. The same fictional adult nurse, recognizable face but with a tied-back ponytail, sits on a row of worn teal molded seats. She has just put a small cardboard pastry box and a little wrapped metal cake knife onto the seat beside her, glancing over the camera with bright quiet amusement, like she is saving a seat for a friend. Passengers blurred in rear, dark water at left through square window and shoreline bokeh restrained. Photo looks candid, cream tube light, nothing staged or opulent.
scenePrompts.public/art/night-ferry/booth.webp: Landscape 3:2. Evening a year later at the small convenience-store counter near the Shanghai Puxi ferry. The lid holds two small yellow candles, one squashed. Bus shelter and rain-dark pavement soft in window, ordinary real store lighting and blurred rows of bottles, no visible labels.
